16580098_b68e7549.text: it was previously shown that SF1 is expressed transiently by the developing hypothalamus including the ventrolateral subdivision of VMH (vlVMH). This expression is absent in vlVMH of adult mice (Cheung et al., 2013). These findings suggest that all VMH neurons require SF1 expression during development, but SF1 may be dispensable in adult vlVMH neurons.
